title: No Secret Scenes! What You Need to Know About Mortal Kombat 2's Credits
summary:
Are you excited for the new Mortal Kombat II movie? It's packed with awesome fighters like Johnny Cage, Kitana, and Scorpion, all battling to save Earthrealm. But before you go see it, you might be wondering: should you stay in your seat after the movie ends to catch a secret scene?

Lots of big action movies these days hide extra scenes during or after the credits. Sometimes they tease a sequel or show a funny moment. But for Mortal Kombat II, the answer is simple: nope, there are zero extra scenes. No mid-credits scene, no post-credits scene — nothing at all. Once the credits start rolling, the movie is totally done.

That means you don't have to sit through all the names of the people who worked on the film (unless you want to!). You can jump up, stretch your legs, and head to the lobby to talk about all the epic fights you just saw. The director, Simon McQuoid, and the studio decided not to add any stingers this time. So go enjoy the brutal action and don't worry about missing anything after the screen goes dark.
why_it_matters: You don't have to sit through the credits after the movie, so you can get home faster or start talking about the cool fights with your friends right away.

background_read: Lots of superhero and action movies hide funny or exciting clips during the credits—these are called stingers. The Mortal Kombat movies are based on a long-running video game series where fighters from different realms battle.
The first Mortal Kombat movie in this new version came out in 2021, directed by Simon McQuoid (who also directed the 2021 film).
Many big movie series, like the Marvel films, use stingers to tease upcoming stories and make fans excited for the next chapter.
